name: Break It Obby! (UPD) [2 Player Obby]
desc:
🧨 BREAK EVERYTHING IN SIGHT and conquer the obby with your buddy! 🧨

Break It Obby! is a wild 2-player co-op obby where everything can be destroyed! Team up with a friend, smash your way through the course, and use your unique abilities to overcome epic challenges together.

🤜 Choose your role:
Melee Player: throw your teammate across tricky gaps!
Ranged Player: pull your friend toward you and cross huge distances!

🎯 Your mission:
-- Activate buttons and levers together to open the path forward.
-- Destroy walls, floors, and anything in your way!
-- Unlock awesome ability and destruction skins as you progress!
🚀 The higher you go, the harder it gets. Can you break it all and survive?
